newsitem.title: USA: Panaco Inc Q1 earnings lower.
newsitem.headline: Panaco Inc Q1 earnings lower.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: '97 Q1 includes increased interest expense from debt incurred in 1996 to acquire 16 offshore blocks from Amoco Production Co. The results also reflect 2.0 million common shares issued to Amoco for the purchase. In addition, Panaco recently completed an offering of six million common shares, and the proceeds were used to pre-pay $13.5 million of 12 percent subordinated debt and pay $8.5 million on the company's revolving bank loan.
'96 Q1 includes the Bayou Sorrel Field, which was sold effective Septermber 1, 1996, the company said.
